stages.script:
set -eu
export PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data
if [ ! -s "${PGDATA}/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  mkdir -p "${PGDATA}"; chown -R postgres:postgres "${PGDATA}"
  su postgres -c "initdb -D ${PGDATA} -U postgres --auth=trust --encoding=UTF8"
fi
su postgres -c "pg_ctl -D ${PGDATA} -l /tmp/postgres.log -o '-c listen_addresses=localhost -c port=5432' start"
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres
if ! psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='workloom'" | grep -q 1; then
  psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE workloom OWNER postgres;" >/dev/null
fi
psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d workloom -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;" >/dev/null

su postgres -c "pg_ctl -D ${PGDATA} -l /tmp/postgres.log -o '-c listen_addresses=localhost -c port=5432' start"
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres
if ! psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='workloom'" | grep -q 1; then
  psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE workloom OWNER postgres;" >/dev/null
fi
psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -d workloom -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;" >/dev/null
